figmaSource.historicalNamedRevisionScope: F1 Settings General Pilot only; not asserted as the current live revision

designDelta.oldValue: Settings General inherited the generic 390x878 settings-stack frame and 112px content bottom padding.
designDelta.newValue: The canonical Phone route is explicitly 390x844 with the source 8px 19px 12px scroll-content padding.

designDelta.oldValue: A 760px viewport entered the generic expanded-width 560px shell.
designDelta.newValue: Settings General alone maps its 760x960 canvas to the Tablet master without changing any other route's responsive policy.

designDelta.oldValue: Theme segment used generic compact geometry and did not provide the master hit target.
designDelta.newValue: The control is 168x36 with 54x30 visible options inside 54x44 targets; selected state is the Figma green 1.25px border and no shadow.

designDelta.oldValue: Switches inherited a smaller generic visual/control box.
designDelta.newValue: Each is a 44x44 keyboard-reachable target with a 44x24 visible track and 20px thumb, without an elevation shadow.

designDelta.oldValue: Select values inherited generic sizing and typography.
designDelta.newValue: Language is 104x28 and the two short values are 88x28; values are Inter 12px regular and right-aligned inside source-like fields.

designDelta.oldValue: Inline actions inherited pill geometry and a small generic hit region.
designDelta.newValue: The visible action is 55x34/r6 inside its 55x44 target; cache keeps the approved 66px exception.

acceptance.viewportPolicy: Landscape remains a Tablet alias; no Compact, Fold, or independent landscape master is introduced.
geometryAndTypography: Headless browser inspection at 390x844: page root was exactly 390x844; content viewport was 388x710; root computed box-shadow was none.
Headless browser inspection at 760x960: page root was exactly 760x960; content viewport was 758x826; root computed box-shadow was none.
All page section cards are 1px #c1c7cd, r8, rgba(255,252,248,.9), and shadow-free. Settings title uses the existing macOS Songti SC source; control typography loads Inter with existing CJK fallback.
The theme segment, select fields, switches and inline actions are right-aligned through the same trailing row edge; no global control primitive was changed.
interaction: Real browser click and keyboard Space toggle the approved switches through ReaderD2SettingsSyncRenderers.settingsGeneral and update aria-checked after rerender.
Real browser click and keyboard Enter select the approved ThemeSegment option through the same owner and update aria-pressed after rerender.
Clicking Language leaves no unapproved option list, dialog or sheet in the DOM and does not mutate the D2 language value.
acceptance.browserVerification: Local agent-browser session loaded the route, showed meaningful content, reported no framework error overlay and no page errors. The session was closed after Phone, Tablet, click and keyboard checks.

pendingFigmaDesignBoundary.reason: Current Settings General Figma nodes have no linked/attached source design for these transient surfaces. The uninstantiated generic Primitive/OptionList is not an approved Settings menu source.
pendingFigmaDesignBoundary.rule: Do not revive legacy appState.settingsOverlay or invent a replacement until Figma supplies the relevant components/prototype states and the user confirms them.

boundary: This is a local-only backport of the existing Figma Settings General page and its directly visible control states. It does not write Figma, alter preserved Figma pages/components/reactions, create detached frames, redefine UiEvent or state ownership, enter Motion Reference, modify Search/Sync Backup, or change any native client. The connector cannot expose an official current Figma revision after the live node reads, so no current revision is fabricated.
